title: Which file gets loaded?
description:
Follow the DLL search order to see which copy of a DLL a program would load.

```
looking for helper.dll:
  C:\Game\                 found -> loads C:\Game\helper.dll
looking for zlib.dll:
  C:\Game\                 no
  C:\Windows\System32\     no
  C:\Windows\              no
  current folder           found -> loads C:\Users\me\Downloads\zlib.dll  (dangerous!)
```
hints: `files[folder].count(name)` tells whether a folder has the file (lesson 4.01).
Known DLLs (like `kernel32.dll`) always come from System32, so check that list first.
requirements: A list of folders in the order the lesson gives, and a set of files present in each.
Print each folder checked and where the search stops.
Warn when the file comes from the current folder or the `PATH`.
